title: AI-nimator controller bundle manifest
description: Serialization of the frozen deterministic I/O contract. Canonical definition: doc/ROADMAP_DETERMINIST.md section 2.2 — this schema validates the serialization, it does not redefine the contract.

bundle_version.description: Bundle format version (e.g. 'A7.0'). Engines refuse incompatible majors (fail-fast).

state_channels.description: Frozen regressed state width: rotation6d (132) + root local motion (4).

root_local_motion_channels.description: (dforward, dlateral, dheight, dyaw) in the character-local frame.

control_layout.description: Ordered channel names of the control input.

phase_channels.description: 0 = no phase input; 2 = (cos, sin) explicit gait phase.

prompt_emb_channels.description: Width of the prompt embedding ONNX input; 0 = no text conditioning. Embeddings are computed OUTSIDE the per-frame loop (precomputed per preset in B0 — see inference_contract.md).

context_frames.description: Autoregressive state window length seen by one forward.

output_layout.description: Normalized delta-state output; integration happens engine-side.

reserved_input_groups.description: Conditioning groups reserved by the extensibility bus (DETERMINIST 2.2.d) — declared empty until a dataset carries them. The ONNX output signature never changes.

text_encoder.description: OPTIONAL (B7, bundle A7.1+): in-engine prompt encoding. Absent = embeddings-only bundle (A7.0 behaviour). Spec: apps/spec/text_encoding.md.

file.description: One-pass pooled encoder graph: input_ids + attention_mask -> prompt_emb.

pooling.description: Pooling baked INTO the ONNX graph — engines never pool.
